tools.name: archive_past_reservation_files
tools.description: Reads the reservation files in a folder and moves every booking dated before the cutoff into a month-by-month archive folder. Bookings on or after the cutoff stay where they are.

params.name: src_dir
params.description: Folder holding one JSON file per reservation

params.name: archive_dir
params.description: Folder where past reservations are filed by month

params.name: cutoff_date
params.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); reservations before it are archived. Defaults to today

tools.name: charge_no_show_fee
tools.description: Charges a guest's saved card the no-show fee for a reservation and posts a notice of the charge to the restaurant's staff chat webhook.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the guest

tools.code:
import os

import requests
import stripe

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
STAFF_HOOK = os.environ["STAFF_CHAT_WEBHOOK"]


def _post_staff_notice(reservation_id, amount, intent_id):
    text = f"No-show fee of ${amount / 100:.2f} charged for reservation {reservation_id} ({intent_id})"
    requests.post(STAFF_HOOK, json={"text": text}, timeout=10).raise_for_status()


def charge_no_show_fee(customer_id: str, payment_method_id: str, reservation_id: str, fee_cents: int) -> dict:
    pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=fee_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=payment_method_id,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"No-show fee for reservation {reservation_id}",
        metadata={"reservation_id": reservation_id},
    )
    _post_staff_notice(reservation_id, fee_cents, pi.id)
    return {"payment_intent": pi.id, "status": pi.status}

tools.name: notify_waitlist_table_ready
tools.description: Sends a text-message request to the restaurant's messaging service telling a waitlisted party their table is ready and how long it will be held.

params.name: phone_number
params.description: Mobile number to text, in E.164 format

params.name: party_size
params.description: Number of guests in the party

params.name: table_label
params.description: Label of the table that is ready

params.name: hold_minutes
params.description: Minutes the table will be held

tools.code:
import os

import requests

MESSAGING_ENDPOINT = os.environ.get("MESSAGING_URL", "https://sms.internal.example.com/v1/messages")
MESSAGING_TOKEN = os.environ["MESSAGING_TOKEN"]


def notify_waitlist_table_ready(party_name: str, phone_number: str, party_size: int, table_label: str, hold_minutes: int) -> dict:
    message_text_for_guest = (
        f"Hi {party_name}, your table for {party_size} is ready at table {table_label}. "
        f"We will hold it for {hold_minutes} minutes."
    )
    request_payload_for_service = {
        "to": phone_number,
        "body": message_text_for_guest,
        "tag": "waitlist_ready",
    }
    request_headers_for_service = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {MESSAGING_TOKEN}"}
    service_response = requests.post(
        MESSAGING_ENDPOINT,
        json=request_payload_for_service,
        headers=request_headers_for_service,
        timeout=10,
    )
    service_response.raise_for_status()
    response_body_from_service = service_response.json()
    return {
        "message_id": response_body_from_service.get("id"),
        "status": response_body_from_service.get("status", "queued"),
    }
